messages:
alex.k: Heads-up: need final HW partner pricing inputs for our cost model by EOD Wednesday. Focus: reserved instance tiers, spot discounts, min supply commitments. @sam-hw-ops can you pull the latest commitments? :calendar:

sam-hw-ops: on it. I have draft numbers from VoltAI and Theta last week. VoltAI RI tiers: 3mo 10% off, 12mo 25% off, 36mo 40% off (GPU: A100/H100/L40 vary). Spot discounts: 60-75% off but preemption 1-6% depending on region. I'll paste csv in a sec.

alex.k: Please include supply caps per region and lead times for replacing failed nodes. We need per-GPU hourly baseline too.

sam-hw-ops: ```vendor,region,gpu,ri_3mo_pct,ri_12mo_pct,ri_36mo_pct,spot_pct,spot_preempt_rate,supply_cap,gpu_hour_usd,lead_time_days
VoltAI,us-west,A100,10,25,40,65,2,1200,2.50,14
VoltAI,us-east,H100,10,25,40,60,4,600,4.20,21
Theta,eu-central,A100,8,22,38,70,1,300,2.60,30
```

maria.pm: This is great. Also need any marketplace listing fees or revenue share for cloud marketplaces (Azure/AWS/GCP). Some partners take 15%+ listing fees.

tej: note: Theta requires co-marketing approval for any joint announcement; 6 week lead time. VoltAI open to press but wants an engineering review window.

lauren-sales: For contracts — reserved capacity SLAs: VoltAI offers 99.9% on dedicated pools, credits for downtime. Important for Dedicated pitch.

alex.k: Action items: @sam-hw-ops update sheet with per-region availability zones and spot volatility, @maria.pm add marketplace rev-share column and any legal constraints, @tej confirm announcement timelines with partners. I'll consolidate into the pricing model. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 (internal). :thumbsup:

partners-bot: Reminder — Partner sync w/VoltAI on Thurs 10am PT (calendar invite sent).

sam-hw-ops: Done. CSV uploaded to sheet, added notes about test quota. Spot preemptions spike in APAC during end-of-month. :warning:

maria.pm: Quick Q: should we model spot as usable for low-latency workloads? My inclination: only for batch/async; include 20% performance penalty when using lower-precision quantized variants.

alex.k: Yes — in cost model we will tag spot as 'best-effort' and only allow for non-latency critical routes. We'll build fallback policy to hosted VMs at slightly higher cost.

tej: Also capture any minimum commit thresholds for RI upsell to customers — partners sometimes require backing commitments that affect pricing.

lauren-sales: I'll feed negotiated discounts from deals (3 customers already pushing for H100 reservations).

alex.k: Great. Expect consolidated inputs by Friday AM. If anything urgent ping me directly. :rocket:
